chunks: Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan and Uthman ibn Hamid, from Muhammad ibn Yazdad al-Razi, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Abdallah al-Muzakhraf, from Habib al-Khath'ami, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Al-Mukhtar used to lie about Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them both).
ai.seo_question: What did al-Mukhtar do regarding Ali ibn al-Husayn?
ai.summary: Rijal al-Kashshi records that al-Mukhtar ibn Abi Ubayda al-Thaqafi frequently fabricated statements and attributed them to Ali ibn al-Husayn (Zayn al-Abidin), peace be upon him, to bolster his political legitimacy during the uprising against the Umayyads. This narration serves as a critical scholarly indicator of the authenticity of al-Mukhtar's claims, highlighting the strategic use of the Imam's name to rally support while distinguishing his own authority from the true Imamate.

en.ammaar-muslim: 2. [2/-] Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad b. al-Hasan and Uthman b. Hamid from Muhammad b. Yazdad al-Razi from Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi al-Khattab from Abdallah b. Muzakhraf from Habib al-Khath’ami from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام who said:
al-Mukhtar used to lie about Ali b. al-Husayn عليهما السلام
